# --- SYSENTER from 64-bit CPL3 (entered with SYSEXIT REX.W, IA32_SYSENTER_CS = 10H: CS 33H, SS 3BH; RFLAGS
# set by POPFQ at CPL0 before it, SYSEXIT keeps them): RBX / RDI = CS / SS at CPL3, R15 = PUSHFQ image at the
# handler k (IA32_SYSENTER_EIP), R12 / R13 = CS / SS there, R14 = RSP - (IA32_SYSENTER_ESP) = 0
